name: Slayer Ascension [🎉INFINITY CASTLE]
desc:
⭐️ Welcome to Slayer Ascension⭐️

NOTE: New and improved version of Slayer Infinity. We are the original creators. 
Our group was taken from us, and we couldn't retrieve it, so we made a new game.
Thanks for reading!

💪 Train to get stronger 💪
⚔️ Fight enemies to get new weapons ⚔️
❤️ Rebirth to increase Health and Strength mult ❤️
🌊 Wave Defense to Rank Up and gain Buffs 🌊
♾️ Climb the Infinity Tower to get auras ♾️
🔥 Learn different Breathing Styles 🔥
🏺 Fight minibosses to get relics 🏺

😎 Premium: 20% Strength boost
⌛ Playtime: 5% Strength and Coins every 20 min (30% max)
